researcher: Maps research agent (web search, public sources)
scope: Identity, activity and capability evidence for employers relevant to three role contexts: temperature-controlled storage finance, property-development finance and agricultural-commodity finance. Public company information only. No people, no client assignments.
method: Each fact cites the retrieved source and states what that source actually supports. Company-owned websites support 'confirmed'; reputable news, academic and trade sources support 'probable'; third-party data aggregators support 'probable' for descriptive facts and 'hypothesis' for numeric scale estimates. Sources published more than 365 days before observation are flagged stale by the graph builder.
